text.en: Clients frequently commend Eddie and his grooming team for their warm customer service and clear communication on Studewood Street. Pet parents appreciate that staff members take time to consult on specific styling preferences and readily accommodate schedule adjustments or early morning drop-offs.

title.en: Skilled breed styling and neat cuts

text.en: Reviewers largely praise the haircuts, highlighting well-executed doodle trims, clean teddy bear styling, and de-shedding baths. While the majority report pets returning home neatly trimmed and smelling fresh, a few customers note occasional unevenness when requesting specialized scissor work on long coats.

Pet owners emphasize that groomers show genuine patience with sensitive and nervous dogs. Reviewers mention that pets appear relaxed rather than stressed during grooming sessions, with staff taking extra care to keep animals comfortable throughout baths and nail trims.

q.en: Do they accommodate cats for grooming?

a.en: Yes, the salon provides grooming services for both dogs and cats on Studewood Street.

q.en: Can pet owners request specific groomers?

a.en: Yes, regular clients frequently book appointments directly with specific groomers such as Jose, Jimmy, and Brenda.

q.en: Are same-day or last-minute appointments possible?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the owner often accommodates short-notice requests or early drop-offs when scheduling permits.
